label: Chemical facility
description: A chemical plant, distributor, terminal or fertilizer site holding RMP/PSM-regulated quantities: process units on a DCS with a separate safety instrumented system, tank farms and loading racks, an emergency response team, and a fence-line community that may need to shelter in place.

vocabulary.facility: the site (process units, tank farm, loading racks and the control room)
vocabulary.public: the fence-line community, nearby schools and the site workforce
vocabulary.frontline: board operators, outside operators, shift supervisors, emergency response team members, maintenance technicians, security officers
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the control room and the site emergency operations center

it: ERP (production, inventory, quality), LIMS and MES
logistics: rail car tracking, truck scheduling, bills of lading and hazmat shipping papers
SDS management and chemical inventory (Tier II)
ot: safety instrumented system (SIS) on a separate logic solver
PLCs for packaging, loading racks and utilities
fixed fire, gas and toxic gas detection
deluge, foam and water curtain systems
tank level gauging and overfill protection
emergency shutdown and isolation valves, relief systems, flares and scrubbers
community warning sirens and the site weather station
vendor remote access and engineering workstations

roles.name: Emergency Coordinator / Site Incident Commander
roles.description: Activates the emergency response plan, declares the emergency class, asks the county for shelter-in-place or evacuation, and calls mutual aid.

roles.name: Operations Superintendent / Shift Supervisor
roles.description: Owns the unit shutdown sequence, isolating inventory and the safe-park decisions.

roles.name: Process Control / OT Engineer (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns DCS and SIS integrity, isolating the control network and validating SIS logic before any reset.

roles.name: Environmental, Health and Safety Manager
roles.description: Owns the reportable-quantity call and the NRC, SERC, LEPC and OSHA notifications.

roles.name: Facility Security Officer
roles.description: Owns the site security plan, access control, theft and diversion response, and the law-enforcement liaison.

roles.name: Community Relations / Communications Manager (PIO)
roles.description: Owns sirens and the community notification line, neighbors and schools, and the media.

outsideParties: the railroad and the trucking carriers
mediaChannels: local TV with aerial footage of the plume
residents' videos of the flare and smoke on TikTok and X
national outlets for a large release

sceneAnchors.public: a residential street next to a chemical plant fence line, distillation columns and flare stacks behind the houses, residents standing in their yards, daylight
sceneAnchors.control: inside a chemical plant control room: board operators at DCS consoles with several monitors, an alarm summary display, a shift supervisor standing behind them, low lighting
sceneAnchors.exterior: a chemical plant process area: steel pipe racks, distillation columns, storage spheres and tanks, a loading rack with a rail tank car, workers in flame-resistant clothing and hard hats, overcast sky
